name: After § 26
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: 26b. Opposes any attempt to renationalise the CAP, which would entail less funding and more conditionality; is opposed to merging cohesion and social policy by integrating the CAP into the NRRPs, as this would bring the governance of Europe’s agriculture into a centralised bureaucracy, obfuscate the objectives and water down responsibilities; stresses that such reforms would jeopardise agricultural policy, which until now has been easy to identify, had its own budget, has been underpinned by national priorities and has been key to the stability of agricultural incomes; reaffirms that the CAP must continue to be a distinct, cogent and predictable policy, a pillar of Europe’s food sovereignty and a tool that provides stability for farmers;
